sandbachFocus: Sandbach United, currently top of the table with 22 points from 10 games, host Alsager Town on Saturday 3 October at 15:00. Sandbach come into this fixture on the back of a recent loss, though their overall form remains strong with seven wins from their last six matches. Alsager Town sit bottom of the division with just 4 points and are winless in their last five outings, making this a favorable matchup for the league leaders.
divisionWide: Second-placed Stafford Town face a stiff test away at Dawley Town on Saturday, looking to maintain pressure on leaders Sandbach after their own recent loss. AFC Bridgnorth, third in the table, host Eccleshall in what is a meeting of two sides in good form—Eccleshall have won their last match while Bridgnorth are unbeaten in three. Wolverhampton Casuals entertain Wednesfield Community on Saturday before facing Brereton Social in a midweek Wednesday 7 October clash. In-form Bilston Town (five wins in their last six) travel to Foley Meir, while Barnton host Shawbury United in a fixture between mid-table and struggling sides. Market Drayton Town welcome New Mills in a contest between sides searching for consistent form, and Cheadle Heath Nomads visit Telford Town in a basement-area clash. Crewe host fellow struggling outfit Allscott Heath, and Brereton Social face Widnes Town on Saturday—both teams battling against relegation concerns, with Widnes in particular struggling at the bottom end of the division.
